info.title: Pangram AI Text Detection
info.description: Detect AI-generated, AI-assisted, and human-written text via Pangram Labs. Payment per request via the x402 protocol (USDC, Circle Gateway facilitator, GatewayWalletBatched scheme). Price: $0.10 per 1,000 words, rounded up; same body always quotes the same price. Unpaid requests to the paid endpoint receive HTTP 402 with a base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header listing payment requirements; clients retry with a payment-signature header.

200.description: Service metadata: payment protocol, facilitator, seller address, pricing, endpoint list.
Word count and exact price the paid call will charge for this body.

402.description: Payment requirements at the minimum price, in the base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (x402).

post.summary: AI-text detection (paid: $0.10 per 1,000 words, rounded up)
post.description: x402-paid endpoint. Without a valid payment-signature header, responds 402 with payment requirements (11 mainnet chains, USDC, GatewayWalletBatched). With a settled payment, runs Pangram Labs detection and returns the full result.

prediction.description: Overall verdict: e.g. AI Generated, Human Written, Mixed.

fraction_ai.description: Fraction of the text classified as AI-generated (0–1).

windows.description: Per-window analysis with AI likelihood and AI-assistance scores.

402.description: Payment required. Base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header carries the x402 payment requirements (price, USDC asset per chain, payTo address).

502.description: Upstream detection failed after payment settled; response includes a refund note. Rare — input is validated before payment is demanded.

text.description: The text to analyze. Must contain at least a few words; very short inputs are rejected with 422 before any payment is taken.
text.example: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence has transformed numerous industries...

Unprocessable.description: Text too short to analyze. Rejected before payment.
